status_summary: On 2025-01-22 a Senate cloture motion to proceed to S. 6, the Senate version of the Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act, failed 52 to 47 (Record Vote No. 11). The House passed H.R. 21, the same act, 217 to 204 on 2025-01-23 (Roll Call 27), and it was received in the Senate and referred to the Judiciary Committee on 2025-01-24; no later Senate action was found. No HHS enforcement announcement under EMTALA or Section 504 and no revival of the proposed hospital and disability rule was found, and a Federal Register search for born-alive EMTALA documents since 2025-01-20 returned none. Both bills were introduced before the period (H.R. 21 on 2025-01-03, S. 6 on 2025-01-15), and the GovInfo bill status records show no action after 2025-01-24 and 2025-01-22 respectively.

timeline.event: The Senate rejected, 52 to 47 (Record Vote No. 11), a motion to invoke cloture on the motion to proceed to S. 6, the Senate's Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act.
House passed H.R. 21, the Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act, 217 to 204 (Roll Call 27).
H.R. 21 received in the Senate, read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.
